description: Mark a memory stale by id so recall stops surfacing it (agents stop applying it), while it stays retrievable for audit - prefer this over forget when knowledge is superseded rather than wrong. Optionally set replaced_by to the id of the replacement memory. Set restore=true to un-deprecate.

id.description: id is the memory (collection) id to deprecate.

replacedBy.description:
replaced_by optionally names the collection id of the replacement memory (a
 citable successor). Ignored when restore=true.

restore.description:
restore=true un-deprecates the memory (clears deprecated + replaced_by).
 Default false deprecates it.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: deprecate
title: Mark a memory stale
